questions.q: If PATIENT is written as SDWLHQW in a certain code, how is SUMMER written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 3 places forward: SUMMER → VXPPHU. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Rahul walks 3 km East, then turns left and walks 4 km. How far is Rahul from the starting point?
questions.why: The two legs are at right angles: √(3² + 4²) = 5 km. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If MOTHER is written as PRWKHU in a certain code, how is KNIGHT written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 3 places forward: KNIGHT → NQLJKW. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 10:30?
A woman introduces a man as the son of her mother's brother. How is the man related to the woman?
questions.why: Her mother's brother is her uncle, and his son is her cousin.
Proverbial favourite food. GPSC's key: Fish. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Suresh is the father of Vijay. Vijay is the son of Pooja. Pooja is the wife of Suresh. How is Pooja related to Vijay?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Mother. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In the word PANCHAYAT, how many letters lie between the first A and the last A?
questions.why: The first A is the 2nd letter and the last A is the 8th. Between them are N, C, H, A, Y: five letters.
